state.description: The door connected, the invitation waiting, and how much history was copied here: {connected, error, invitation, copied}.

connect.description: Starts this chat's SimpleX door (its own small container) and tells it where this chat's inbox is, with the secret its deliveries carry (SIMPLEX_DOOR_SECRET).

link.description: A one-time SimpleX invitation from the door, for its owner's app to scan.

status.description: The door's own state: its start, its saves, its link.

copy.description: Its owner copies their old SimpleX chat here, once, before it is bound: each record as it was (who said it, when), marked copied, each once.

meta.title: SimpleX
meta.description: A chat with your agent that you also reach from your SimpleX app, end to end encrypted to the platform's door.
